policy_before_mutation.title: Governance Boundary
policy_before_mutation.description: No side effects bypass the policy engine. Actions are vetted through SMT solvers or jsonLogic prior to taking place.

provenance_before_commit.title: Deterministic Replayability
provenance_before_commit.description: Every step in the DAG creates W3C PROV-O provenance linked data representing the Entity, the Activity, and the Agent. Human overrides are treated solely as Candidate Evidence.

frozen_context.title: Context Freezing
frozen_context.description: Analytical parameters are frozen into an immutable Context Object upon creation. The state is hashed and injected as W3C PROV metadata.

deterministic_numeric_execution.title: Rust Compute Kernels
deterministic_numeric_execution.description: Native math occurs only inside compiled Rust kernels using isolated deterministic routines bounded by the abi3-py310 standard, releasing the GIL using py.allow_threads().

decoupled_architecture.title: Separation of Concerns
decoupled_architecture.description: LLMs propose, Policy authorizes, Rust executes.

fail_closed_security.title: Default Deny
fail_closed_security.description: Unknown intent defaults to denied. LLMs request actions, which default to fail-closed postures if untracked.

mcp_isolation.title: Model Context Protocol
mcp_isolation.description: Agents interact with the world strictly through MCP, guarded by Intent Gates. This secures boundaries against agent goal hijacking.

stateless_swarm.title: Ephemeral System 1
stateless_swarm.description: System 1 is ephemeral and non-blocking, parsing chaos to typed schema.

agent_consensus.title: Conflict Resolution
agent_consensus.description: Orchestrator resolves conflict via logic rules over a DAG for deterministic paths.

core_paradigms.probabilistic_cognition: LLMs operate solely as orchestrators proposing intent, scenario construction, and anomaly detection.
core_paradigms.deterministic_governance: All actions are intercepted by a policy engine before state mutation.
core_paradigms.stochastic_simulation: Adversarial perturbation against bounded financial inputs.
core_paradigms.verifiable_execution: Native math occurs only inside compiled Rust kernels (e.g., VaR, stress tests, Monte Carlo models).
